reviews.text: The staff was absolutely amazing with Rocky and with his owner. Thank goodness for the personal treatment and consideration to pet owners

My dog was having seizures out of no where. The situation was getting scary and we did not have insurance or the funds to take him to an emergency vet who would have charged us an arm and a leg. We called a few vets and they all told us to go to an emergency vet all except FM 1960 animal hospital. They set realistic expectations while treating him at a fair price that we could afford. They went above and beyond to accommodate us from working us in between clients, giving us snacks and blankets, allowing us to stay for monitoring and treatment for two whole days during my dog’s time of need. They figured out which medicines helped calm his seizures and didn’t let us leave until he was stable. They saved my dog’s life and there’s no words that’s can say thank you for what they did. I absolutely recommend this place because they treated my dog like it was theirs. From the head vet to the techs who assisted us through the process all around top of the line service here. I honestly believe they deserve the gold standard for pet care not just cause they solved the seizure problem but because they could have turned us down like all the other vets but they at least gave it their best shot and succeeded. Special shout out to Devan who gave us her personal cell incase an emergency happened or if we just had any questions. Thank you for everything!

First, it’s important to say that Dr. Laurence is a great vet to have take care of your pet. But, some of her staff have bad attitudes and makes the visit here not worth it. I call to speak to Dr. Laurence but she’s always busy. I leave a message to have her call me, but I never get a return call. It’s easy to see she does not get the message and her staff is hiding something.
Dr Grasshoff and the entire team there were great. That was my first visit with my 12 y/o cat and now the are my new primary veterinarian clinic. I am glad I went there and highly recommend them.
Great staff, facility and location!
The staff there is always so nice and caring. They truly put the needs of your pets before anything else.
It was fine.

The caring, compassion, and understanding that was shown by every member of the staff was such a comfort.  My dog had no fear, he trusted them completely. That is so important to the animal's parents.  Thank you so much.
Great
Everyone was very nice and helpful! I've known Dr Grasshoff for a long time and I wouldn't choose to go anywhere else!
Excellent place, I recommend it 100%.
The veterinarians were very helpful and understanding and very nice. My brother in law took his pets here, and now I do. Wonderful family vet. Definitely suggest them.
Staff cares and Dr knows what she's doing. Bring your pet here.
Everyone is very attentive and friendly. From the front desk to the vet techs to the vets(Dr. Lawrence and Sr Grasshoff) My dog loves both of them.

Very compassionate staff and Veterinarian. I was not a regular customer, but went for an emergency because they are located close to my home.  They saw my cat immediately and were so attentive and kind.  I will definitely be returning for regular care.
Took my little dog in for her vaccinations. All went well.  Dr. Grasshoff and the staff were great as always.
Great Staff and Vets

FM 1960 Animal Hospital has been more like family than just a vet clinic. I have been bringing my pets to them for over four years and trust them implicitly to take great care of my animals.

When I first discovered them, they helped take great care of two elderly cats up until their passing, and now manage the health of my dog and two more cats.

They are both professional and fun, and every visit is a joy. An added bonus is that I have yet to receive a bill that seemed in any way unreasonable, so prices are a plus as well!

Best service i had for my dog 'i went to other vets and tried to charge me 800 for check up and tried to charge me stuff I ain't ask for 'I came to this place and the 2 females on the front desk were very friendly ' a gorgeous receptionists was able to put me and my dog in a room since my dog isn't friendly with other dogs ' the doctor and her assistant were straight forward and honest and helpful , would definitely be back for my dogs vaccines
Would definitely recommend this place to other people .

Dr. Grasshoff helped me with my two dogs, especially with the upcoming thunderstorms and fireworks! Prior,  I left a VCA veterinary office where you never knew what veterinarian would take care of your pets!

The FM 1960 Veterinarian facility is very nice and clean.  Their professional's in the office are caring and knowledgeable. We are blessed to have had their help. Appointments are always timely and if any waiting is involved, we are notified beforehand.
Doctor Grasshoff has been our veterinary for close to 20 years.  She is very knowledgeable, courteous, affectionate to our fur babies, and professional.  So glad to have had a personal referral from a close acquaintance.
The practice/facility, FM 1960 Animal Hospital, is both veterinarian services and hospital services. They have an experienced veterinary team, including Dr. Vickie Lawrence and Dr. Donna Grasshoff, and focus on building long-term relationships with pet owners through individualized treatment plans.
You will find their website offers financing through Scratchpay, a mobile app for managing pet healthcare, handles online appointment scheduling, as well as new client promotions.
I believe the website correctly reviews FM 1960 Animal Hospital as a long-established, community-focused veterinary practice committed to delivering high-quality medical care, preventive health services, and compassionate support for pets throughout their lives.
Their professional, knowledgeable, compassionate, caring group gets the highest review I can give for their dedication.
The website tells us that FM 1960 Animal Hospital is a full-service veterinary clinic in Houston, Texas. They have been providing care for cats and dogs since 1975. The professionals that work there emphasize compassionate, personable veterinary care.  They offer comprehensive services for pets at every stage of life, from routine wellness visits to advanced diagnostics and surgery.
The site explains that their services include:
•	Preventive care, wellness exams, vaccinations, and parasite prevention
•	Dental care and cleanings
•	Diagnostic imaging (digital X-rays and ultrasound) and laboratory testing
•	Spay/neuter and soft tissue surgery
•	Laser therapy and platelet-rich plasma (PRP) treatments
•	Boarding and daycare
•	Domestic and international health certificates for pet travel
•	End-of-life care, including euthanasia and cremation services
Again, the practice of FM 1960 Animal Hospital has an experienced veterinary team, including Dr. Vickie Lawrence and Dr. Donna Grasshoff, and focus on building long-term relationships with pet owners through individualized treatment plans.
It was definitely worth my making an appointment towards keeping our pets healthy!
We did not have an appointment and were taken care of right away.The vet examined our dog and explained what she observed.We were relieved when we left the facility.

They were great taking care of my cat, Sabrina. She was very sick with a respiratory viral infection.  We got 2 shots, nail clipping, and fur clumps removed.  The vet was great showing us how to use the comb to remove fur clumps.  But was great to talk to about Sabrina's illness and what to watch for going forward
They took such good care of Shadow.
Always the best experience. Great care for our pup.
My Gypsy has been going to Doc Grasshoff for almost 6 yrs. IMO, she(and her staff) are the best! I'm grateful to have found them!

They were able to see us very quickly after our cat was injured and gave me an estimate before treatment.  They were very patient and gentle.  And then called me to give me updates on her treatment.  I do recommend them!

Greatest Veterinarian and Animal Hospital ever.  A year ago they saved my kids cat.  Old school vet with reasonable fees.  I noted that a ton of vet services especially in the area are going for a human priced healthcare model with minimal actual inpatient options and price gouging practices.  They must be owned by private equity for the humanity in practice they employ.  You have a pet?  Go to 1960 animal hospital.  They deserve the business.

By the book, my dog has an unexpected tumor and the previous vet just cancelled him, so i asked ChatGPT and it recommended me this clinic, people are nice the vet i got is very experience. So we are waiting for biopsy to see known the course of my dogs future....

This experience for me and my puppy was fantastic. The staff members were kind and gentle with my 21 week old puppy. We went in thinking the worst about my pup’s condition but Dr Grassoff  quickly assessed the situation and came up with a simple solution. She could have taken me to the cleaners but the honesty and genuine care for my animal made this experience great. This vet will be my go to hence forward.
Everyone was helpful. It was good to see Dr. Grasshoff. I trust her. Costs anywhere are hard to handle.
Great and caring staff my dog loves them
We’ve taken our cat, Murphy, to this clinic twice and both times we were pleased with the veterinarian’s diagnosis and treatment.  The entire staff was helpful and courteous.
Very attentive, the nurse quickly diagnosed my pet's condition, the doctor was very nice

Great place to take your pet.  Caring and compassionate to both the pet and the pet parent.  While no dog really "likes" going to the vet, ours didn't seem overly stressed. Very knowledgeable staff. We were a bit concerned when our usual vet merged her business into this location.  We needed be, we not only get the same excellent care we had before, but now with a larger staff and facility.

We had to make the call no pet parent ever wants to make, our fur-baby had been injured. Understanding our fears and concerns, they were able to get us in the same day.  Each of the options for treatment were fully explained and we were able to make the decision as to which direction we wanted to go for treatment.  The care they provided was excellent.  They worked hard to alleviate not only our dog's stress, but ours too.  We never felt rushed, or pressured for additional procedures.  Our girl is now back to her old frisky self.  We appreciated the call a few days after the procedure and treatments to see how she was doing and answer any questions we had.  We highly recommend.
Everyone was very nice. I liked Dr. Lawrenze very much and her staff.
Wonderful experience. The place is warm & inviting. From the front desk on to the vet visit was smooth sailing 💯

I took my baby for a emergency visit The receptionist and veterinary techs were very kind however, the actual veterinarian doctor was kind of very dismissing didn’t really explained to us anything just really asked the same repeated question and kind of just showed non-compassion for my dog in our situation ha Had it not been for the veterinary tech checking and making sure my baby got medicine she probably wouldn’t have given us a prescription For his various serious situation, which is an anal prolapse. The technician was very informative and show compassion. I would give a one overall on the vet, veterinarian not the front desk, staff or the techs
Favorite vet!  The techs are fantastic been taking my dogs cats and a few wild critters here for years!
Love Dr. Grasshoff - she is amazing & so good with animals! Celina (hope I spelled it right lol) goes above and beyond for her customers..always has a smile!

We are always happy with our trips to FM1960 Animal Hospital.  It is easy to make an appointment and the entire staff is friendly, caring and compassionate.  They take time with our pets and provide complete information regarding the exam and any treatment.  Doctor Lawrence has been our vet for over 30+ years and the experience has always been exceptional!  I highly recommend FM 1960 Animal Hospital!
My peeps!  They know how to properly take care of your pets and Freindly too.

Friendly and professional.
Great caring service for you and your pet.
Enjoyed being greeted by Dr. Grasshoff. Seeing Salina & the rest of the crew. Love the new office. Bella is doing well after dental procedure. Thanks for taking care of her.
Great care, airways a little pricey.
The doctors and staff at FM 1960 animal Hospital are very knowledgeable and caring. Dr. Grasshoff and her staff always take the needed time to diagnose, treat and answer any questions that we have.

Dr Lawrence and all the staff are wonderful.  They are professional but also genuinely care about our pets for nearly 20 years.   Now they’re caring for a new puppy in our life. We know she’s in good hands.
It was a stressful experience but everyone made it easier...They took great care of my boys(2 male cats ) .
I had a pretty good experience at this veterinarian office. The staff was friendly, welcoming, and made the visit comfortable.
Overall experience was great with the vet tech and the veterinarian, the younger from office/check in person was not very friendly, was not rude just not personable
They truly care. Dr. Lawrence even called a few days after our visit to follow up - I've never experienced that before.

Our cat Lou has been under Dr. Grasshoff from the beginning. Being a stray he had several issues, but with her expertise he was soon back to good health. When she moved to FM1960 Animal Hospital we did not hesitate to follow her. Dr Grasshoff and her team are excellent, such caring warm people. The hospital is very impressive. I highly recommend it.
Loved the treatment at this place! The vet tech and the vet were super friendly, and sweet to my dog, they responded very educated and helpful to my dogs needs.
Very nice and good with my puppy
This is the best vet anywhere. I drive 20 miles to get there.
Excellent service!

This place nickels and dimes you. I took my sick cat here yesterday (Wednesday) because he had an upper respiratory infection and wasn’t eating after being on antibiotics from another vet since Saturday. After paying this vet $429 for injections and breathing treatments he is still not eating and then they wanted me to bring him in today for more breathing treatments and pay an additional $165. I won’t be coming back here again. They aren’t worried about your animal they just want to make more money- my cat still isn’t eating and is in the exact same condition as he was when I took him in.
Loved being able to see my vet as scheduled. The office staff is great and my cat seemed to do well there too. They were able to get me in the next day which is great.
Treated professionally…received a reassuring assessment
I highly recommend this animal hospital. I've been taking my pets there for years. The vet and the techs are so kind and caring, and very pleasant. Wonderful place!!! ❤️
employees best with animals. gave my pets best treatments and fix all my dogs

I called to make an appointment on a Friday and was able to be seen that same day in the morning (my usual vet didn’t have openings until that Monday). I brought my cat in and unfortunately he passed away in office from his illness. The ladies in this office were so compassionate & kind to me on the darkest day of my life. They explained everything and comforted me in my time of need. I will always remember their kindness!
Kitty spayed. Purrfect service

The Dr is great very easy with my animals
Was easy to talk to

This animal hospital exceeded our expectations! We took our senior dog for an annual exam after relocating here a month ago. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable. We saw Veterinarian Vickie Lawrence, she was great and very informative about the best course of action for our relatively healthy senior pupper. Would definitely recommend!
Very kind and gentle with my baby
Great animal clinic, very professional, helpful with our concerns, and provides loving care for our pets.

This veterinary clinic saved the life of our fur baby that had Parvo Virus by prescribing medications that are proven to be very effective against that disease. The vet staff rendered excellent service from the veterinarian to her staff especially Skyler. My dog tore off her nail. I was worried about infection.  So I called FM1960 animal hospital. They were able to get me in same day. At our appointment I was given a written notice of the procedure and cost $168. This was reasonable so I agreed. When we checked out the cost suddenly jumped from the $168 to $308.94. No explanation for why it doubled in price.

I just switched my cats (2) care from VCA Champions Northwest to FM 1960 Animal Hospital. The receptionist was welcoming, Dr. Peterson (the veterinarian we saw) and Skyler the tech were both amazing! I love supporting local businesses.
Wonderful experience as always
First time visiting 8/12 & 8/13 and both visits were awesome! Great staff and affordable prices. My fur baby has a vet now

I was hesitant to try a new place for Ginger. I highly recommend FM 1960 animal hospital. The veterinarian was very informative and honest she didn't try to charge me for unnecessary test. Price was very affordable! Didn't wait long the staff and vet were very prompt, it worked perfect with my work schedule. Very clean place 👌 …

We dropped Leo our 30 lb cat off Friday morning for the weekend stay and picked him up Monday midday. He looked liked he'd been very well taken care of, brushed and happy. Didn't want to get into the carrier to come home. They never disappoint. We're happy customers

A great cast of well trained & caring professionals! I highly recommend them.

The staff and was very nice at my ariver they were there to help me with my cat and dog to get to the room all the staff members were knowledgeable about the how to handle my there patient makinging all of us feel like home,
As most of us agreed,  going to the vet it's presses but I found my cat and dog was in good hands.

she has full knowledge of how to do her job with a great smile

The office was very sanitary and the air quality was very pleasant. The staff members were professional, courtesy and knowledgeable and the other appointees were in control of their pets, as well as, friendly. I would recommend this veterinarian without hesitation!
The Doctors assistant Devon was exceptionally professional,She new her job well .and took care of my boy Sancho..the whole staff including the Doctor were great.average and  resonabably priced .

This office is right down the street from my home so it’s very convenient. The ladies were very courteous. I Love the service here….. although Crixus 🐕 might say otherwise. Lol. It’s always clean and the employees have EXCELLENT customer service skills and are pet friendly! Thank you guys so much ☺️ Crixus and I will be back! …

Convenient, competent and compassionate - all the things pet parents look for in a veterinarian.  Clean and pleasant facility, nice staff, great doctors.  Not inexpensive but nothing in the medical field is.  I highly recommend this practice.

I've been thrilled with her knowledge, her experience and her bed-side manner.  I highly recommend this clinic.
Very clean Very professional Very welcoming! I wish I could keep coming here if I didn't live in magnolia!

Awesome staff,and Pepe the cat is so playful. Took good care ny babies.

I called Monday and was told I would get a call back that day but that did not happen. Tomorrow will be a week since I took him in.
Wonderful Dr and staff
I can't express how happy I was with this office.  My cat is shy and they handled him gently and he was not afraid of them. 5 star review!

Pros- The clinic is nice, clean. The tech and Dr were prompt.

Cons- neither one introduced themselves when they walked into the room. My cat had a urinalysis and blood work early Monday morning.
Wed and Thursday I had to call to try to get results. No one called me. The Dr never called me to explain anything.

I spoke with whoever answered the phone and they said they would contact the doctor and get back with me.

I thought the doctor not calling herself was unprofessional.
